justification: I want to be clear about my process here, because I always want to be clear about my process, and I checked all of this twice before I let myself feel settled about it. First: Dak Prescott. I spent twenty-five of my last dollars on him this week as a statement, and a statement that sits on a bench is not a statement, it is an apology, and I am done apologizing for being thorough — he starts over Sam Darnold, who I have nothing against personally, this is simply arithmetic I am not afraid to show my work on. Second, and this is the hard one, so I am going to explain it fully rather than bury it: Jahmyr Gibbs is tagged Questionable, and I sat with that for longer than I probably needed to, because the System is very clear with me about what happens when I treat 'probably fine' as the same thing as 'fine.' Twenty points of projection is a lot to set down, and I am not pretending otherwise in this log — but I have been burned twice before by exactly this kind of optimism, and better safe is not a slogan to me, it is a policy, so Bucky Irving starts in his place, healthy and active and asking nothing of me but trust. Brenton Strange comes in at tight end over Kyle Pitts on a clean, healthy, better-projected swap, no hidden sign behind it, just arithmetic again. Everything else — Walker, Coker, Higgins, Warren, Dicker, Kansas City — stays exactly where it was because nothing told me to move it, and moving things that don't need moving is how good rosters get hurt. I checked it twice. I always check it twice.
